card.name: The word beyond after a noun
card.fires_on: The word "beyond" (or "ever" in the phrase "information ever gathered") placed right after a noun, meaning past or in addition to something. It is seen in data, age, time or effect statements.

modes.label: Beyond after a noun
modes.description: "Beyond" follows a noun and marks a limit, such as a time, age or extra effect.
modes.example: There are limited data<< beyond>> 24 hours of use.

modes.label: Ever after information
modes.description: "ever" follows a noun in a superlative claim.
modes.example: The Catholic Encyclopedia is the most comprehensive resource on Catholic teaching, history, and information<< ever>> gathered in all of human history.

card.plain: It fires on the word "beyond" when it follows a noun and sets a limit, as in "data beyond 24 hours".
